name: To The Forbidden Land
unlocks: Wandering Wood (Theodora can enter from this chapter)

meals.note: Simon and Nuzzuo join 7/1. Diego to Support 2 by 7/31; Seteth and Jester (fillers) toward Support 3.

gifts.note: Buy several on the Megaira trip
Buy several on the Megaira trip

missables.text: Finish anything due in August by 7/31: the calendar skips from 7/31 to 8/25
Get Diego to Support 2 by 7/31: Ch 10 and 11 are only buffer
missables.lose: Diego's Ch 12 recruit if Support 2 isn't in by 10/15

note.text: No Advanced exams yet: Renown 8 lands at the very end of Ch 9 at best, so stay in the side trips
detail: Sirocco: take Shaman the day he reaches Lv 20 if he hasn't yet.
Lv 20 exams now: Ultand and Ninae Priest, Loretta Myrmidon, Nydine Armored Ornius Rider.

override.text: On Bucephalus at Lv 20: Flying D, Spear C and Sword C. Equip the Phantom Ring after her story

buy.text: Buy 5 Advanced Licenses in [[place:Megaira]] for priorities 1 to 5 (Ch 10 to 11 exams)
detail: Dagsion sells them only from Ch 10: buy the other 3 (Sirocco, Loretta, Ultand) there.

buy.text: Megaira: 4 [[item:Elixir]] (2,400G) for Theodora, Tobias, Ultand and Ninae (Part II stock)
Megaira: a [[item:Shielding Axe]] for Tobias: Prt +3 on the choke turn
Buy 2 Da Mina weapons as spares for Its Name Is Da Mina (Ch 10)
detail: Hand them in at [[quest:its-name-is-da-mina]] in Ch 10 (20,000G, due 10/24).
Megaira sells the [[item:Da Mina Spear]]; any 2 Da Mina weapons count.
Simon: Iron Axe, Iron Sword, Wooden Gauntlets (Gauntlet trainer). Nuzzuo: Iron Sword, Iron Bow.
Rank C: [[item:Da Mina Sword]] (Alexandra, Loretta), [[item:Da Mina Spear]] (Alexandra), [[item:Da Mina Axe]] (Nydine).

buy.text: Swap Javelins and Hand Axes for [[item:Short Spear]]s and [[item:Short Axe]]s

barter.for: This chapter's battle and Leda's Paralogue (Ch 10): Sofia, Bonaventure, Tobias, Lilian

assign.why: Northern Passage chest after her story: Avo +5, Wt 3
Southern Passage chest: read it at once
Vandahl barter: her Priest accessory, second copy after Sofia's
Dragonbone Tangle chest copy: Res +5 on the wall
Tobias's Vandahl copy, from storage: Hit +5

note.text: Blacksmith +1 week (Renown 7): every Ch 9 row in the Ledger's refine plan
detail: Rare ore: [[item:Mahadu's Spear +1]], [[item:Longbow +1]], [[item:Levin Sword +1]] (Alexandra at Sword C).
Da Mina (ores ?): Alexandra's and Loretta's Swords, Lilian's Bow, Lysander's Spear, Tobias's and Nydine's Axes.
Smithing Stone: Simon's Iron Axe and Sword, Nuzzuo's Iron Sword and Bow, Nydine's Iron Spear.

recruits.action: Call Tails on his coin flip (Support 3, Renown 7): Part II bench axe
detail: About Lv 15 in a Beginner class: Brigand at Lv 20 (Ch 10), Axe C and Sword C from Arena seats.
EXP: every Ch 9 dungeon party; he never takes a Part I slot.
The Nemea Cavern Hammer (Ch 10) is his Part II weapon.

recruits.action: Hand over 3 Iron Bows (Renown 6): bench skirmisher; no Levin Sword at this level
detail: About Lv 15: Rogue at Lv 20 (Ch 10), Bow C and Sword C from Arena Infantry.
Sirocco's Levin Sword comes from Jester (filler, Renown 9) instead.
EXP: dungeon parties with Simon, Nydine and Noctula for the rest of Ch 9.

prep.text: Ultand or Ninae not in yet (Support slipped)? Recruit her this week: the rows are in Ch 8
Simon short of Support 3 on 7/1? Seat him at two tables the first Sunday

route.note: Do it for the gold and Renown: Guardian already carries in from Dietrich's path

explore.text: Bench EXP: Southern Passage, Sand-Shadow Fort, Stoppered Shrine with Simon, Nuzzuo, Nydine, Noctula
detail: Fifth seat: Tobias as the carry; feed the Lv 15 joins the kills.
Link attacks raise Supports too: Simon with Lilian or Ninae.

explore.text: [[place:Southern Passage]] (Lv 25, Nysiades): Salamander and [[item:Archive Z]] for Bonaventure
detail: Dietrich and Theodora only. Run it with your support pairs.

explore.text: Dragonbone Tangle (Lv 20, Nysiades): [[item:Hexlock Shield]] for Ultand
detail: Same desert trip as Southern Passage. Also a Hunter's Ring and a Lucky Coin.

explore.text: Sand-Shadow Fort (Lv 23, Nysiades): [[item:Gundogya]], a cursed axe, Large Bullion
detail: Gundogya is cursed (Curse 1): hold it to the end of Part I (Drifting Reliquary).
Same desert trip as Southern Passage. A Giant always spawns (Giant's Meat).

explore.text: Northern Passage (Theodora only in Part I): Dew of Peace, then Alexandra's [[item:Phantom Ring]]
detail: The Phantom Ring appears only after Alexandra's Ch 9 story section: go back for it.

explore.text: [[place:Wandering Wood]] (Saveilon): [[item:Verdant Gem]] in the Part I chest
detail: Puzzle 1-3-2-1-3: take the path with 1 butterfly, then 3, then 2, then 1, then 3.

explore.text: [[place:Stoppered Shrine]] (Lv 25, Idyia): [[item:Velheit]], a cursed axe, Flower Painting
detail: Velheit is cursed (Curse 1): hold it to the end of Part I (Drifting Reliquary). Mine its Windstone (Levin Sword +2).
Part III: Orchel's axe (Automaton: Curse never moves her gauge).
Flower Painting is a loved gift for Simon.

explore.text: Gather 35 [[gather:Venomstone]] and 35 [[gather:Desert Millet]] for Ch 10's Send Supplies
Recruit Soldiers at [[place:Megaira]] on the License trip: Lions of Megaira for Theodora
detail: [[battalion:Lions of Megaira]] (Megaira only): Rousing Speech (Renown 7), roll until it lands.
Fallback: [[battalion:Silver-Shield Guard]]. Theodora takes it at Authority B (Ch 10 to 11).
Also: [[battalion:Iron-Shield Fighters]] (Ultand, Priest), [[battalion:Steel-Shield Guard]] (her Part II).

explore.text: Assign [[battalion:Regia Breeze Co.]] to Simon on 7/1 and clergy squads to the new Priests
detail: Ultand [[battalion:Iron-Shield Fighters]], Ninae [[battalion:Fighting Clergy]] once each takes Priest.
Transfer Priest Trainees, Mage Pupils and Armored Sentinels once replaced: troop points toward Tactics Manuals.

explore.text: Spend any Turns still left on Inn Auto-Activities

tips.text: The Digamma boss has three health bars: kill the "lively" Digammas first to clear their escorts
Long joins mid-battle with Heal and a [[item:Salamander]]: equip it on him
detail: He isn't on the recruit list, so the plan has no class target for him.

tips.text: Pack Antitoxins: Sofia, Bonaventure, Tobias and Lilian carry one; Lysander uses an open slot
Have Bonaventure cast Swarm Z (Spd -3, range 2) on the foe Tobias or Alexandra hits next
